# Tracked paths exempt from the text-determinism check, one exact path per line.
#
# A path listed here is not checked for its stored line endings, is not checked
# for UTF-8 validity, and is left out of the renormalisation comparison. Nothing
# else exempts a file: the check reads this file and no pattern in the workflow.
#
# An entry is a full path from the repository root, matched exactly. No globs,
# because a glob exempts files nobody looked at, including ones added later.
#
# Add an entry only with the reason on the line above it, and only where the
# file genuinely cannot satisfy the rule. A fixture that must carry a carriage
# return to prove what it exists to prove is the case this list is for. A file
# that is merely inconvenient to fix is not.
#
# The list is empty. Every tracked text file in this repository is stored as
# UTF-8 without a byte order mark and with LF line endings, and none of them
# needs an exception.
